Logistic Regression.name: Logistic Regression
Logistic Regression.description: Linear probabilistic classifier with L2 regularization. High interpretability, but struggles with non-linear soil-moisture-slope interaction thresholds.

Random Forest.name: Random Forest
Random Forest.description: Forest of 160 decision trees. Strong resilience to noisy field sensor feeds and robust capture of slope-moisture threshold cliffs.

XGBoost.name: XGBoost
XGBoost.description: Sequentially boosted shallow trees optimizing log-loss. Exceptional performance on complex interaction surfaces with minimal variance.

winner_reason: Random Forest achieved the highest F1-Score (0.8063) on the holdout test set, striking the optimal balance between disaster detection recall (78.6%) and false-alarm prevention precision (82.7%).
